info.title: be-music Leaderboard API
info.description: Version 0 is the beta: it may still change incompatibly (docs/leaderboard.md section 8). Requests are authenticated with the Better Auth session cookie from `/api/auth/*`; reads are public.

anonymous.description: True until the account has a way back in (a passkey).

avatarUrl.description: The player icon: the uploaded one, or one generated from the account.

401.description: No session: sign in first (anonymously is enough).

handle.description: New handle: letters, digits and `_`, 3 to 15 characters, case-insensitive. The old handle stays reserved for the player and its pages redirect.

displayName.description: New display name: 1 to 32 characters, no line breaks or control characters.

post.description: Submits a play log with its fingerprint documents. The body is JSON, gzip-compressed (`Content-Encoding: gzip`). The server re-simulates the play under every ruleset and answers its figures and ranks. The same play submitted again by the same account answers 200 with the stored result.

playDocument.description: Fingerprint document of the played chart (the rolled branches); it must hash to `chart.playFingerprint`.

chartDocument.description: Fingerprint document of the whole chart (every branch). Required the first time the server sees the chart.

200.description: Already submitted by this account: the stored result.

ruleset.description: Ruleset the figures are simulated under.

rulesetRevision.description: Revision of the ruleset the play was simulated under (`lr2/0`, ...).

clearLamp.description: Clear lamp: 0 NO PLAY, 1 FAILED, 2 ASSIST EASY, 3 EASY, 4 CLEAR, 5 HARD, 6 EX HARD, 7 FULL COMBO, 8 PERFECT, 9 MAX.

rank.description: The player’s rank on the chart after this play.

improved.description: Which personal bests this play improved.

429.description: Too many submissions; retry after `Retry-After` seconds.
